answer: Continuous engagement escrow. Each identity must hold a live attention plume: a rolling 30-day record of verified task completions with response latency under threshold. Miss the window and the identity enters a spiral of decay, losing reputation weight geometrically until it re-qualifies. Value locked in each identity's vault is released only against that record, so an attacker maintaining N identities must staff N parallel attention streams continuously, paying real labor and latency costs per identity per month, with no batch shortcut.
